name: Velvet
source:
Members of St. Aile’s SORD team. [url=/c62419]Sylvie[/url] and Vel are third years, and therefore upperclassmen to [url=/c62418]Gumi[/url] and the others; as older students, they are allowed to wear nuns' habits instead of regular uniforms. They work as a pair during missions.

"Hey there, terrorist scum! You makin' sure to 'love thy neighbor'?"
